summary: Known issues: authentication role mappings list all roles but only Org Admin, Org Member, Team Admin, Team Member and Platform Auditor are supported; upgrading an existing Lightspeed deployment from 2.5 to 2.6 fails until the October 22, 2025 patch (AAP-54064).
questions: Which roles are supported in authenticator role mappings?
Why did Lightspeed fail after upgrading to AAP 2.6?
Can I upgrade Lightspeed from 2.5 to 2.6?
